rule_for_part1: If P1 and P2 both miss, part 1 of the thesis (usage independent of price) is rejected.
rule_for_part2: If P4 or P5 misses, part 2 (holders capture little) is rejected and the case turns bullish.

predictions.claim: Usage holds whatever the price does
predictions.metric: mean weekly NEAR Intents volume, weeks ending 2026-11-22 to 2026-12-13
predictions.rule: at least 50% of the mean of the last 4 weeks at freeze

predictions.claim: Intents keeps its share of onchain trading
predictions.metric: mean weekly Intents share of all DEX volume, weeks ending 2026-11-22 to 2027-01-10
predictions.rule: at least the mean of the 13 weeks before the latest 13 at freeze

predictions.claim: Usage does not simply follow price
predictions.metric: correlation of weekly log changes, Intents volume against NEAR price, 8 weeks ending 2027-01-10
predictions.rule: at most 0.5, the line THESIS.md already uses

predictions.metric: NEAR market cap on 2027-01-10 over Intents revenue in the 364 days to that date

predictions.claim: Buybacks do not offset new supply
predictions.metric: NEAR gained by buybacks.multisignature.near over NEAR added to total supply, blocks at 2026-11-16 and 2027-01-11 00:00 UTC

predictions.claim: Buybacks keep running at a real pace
predictions.rule: at least 10%, a bit over half of the last 13 weeks at freeze (18.7%)

predictions.metric: intents.near storage in bytes at the 2027-01-11 block over the 2026-11-16 block
Intents revenue in the 28 days ending 2026-12-13
predictions.rule: at least half of the 91 day run rate at freeze, scaled to 28 days
